Description

A budget planner that does the adding up for you, opens in any browser, and never asks you to sign up for anything.

Monthly Plan is one HTML file. You download it, double-click it, and it opens like a web page — except everything inside it is yours to edit. Set your plan once and it repeats every month, so you are adjusting a few numbers rather than rebuilding a spreadsheet from scratch. Your figures stay on your own computer.

How It Works:
1. Download the file and save it somewhere you will find it again.
2. Double-click to open it in your browser. Take the two-minute tour, or open Sample Mode to explore a fictional year first.
3. Build your plan once. Every following month starts from it, and you only change what actually changed.
4. Log what you spend as you go, or import your bank's CSV and let it sort the entries for you.
5. Watch the dashboard. It tells you what is genuinely left after your commitments — not just what is in the account.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:
• One HTML budget planner file — no software to install, no subscription, no account
• Monthly dashboard built around one honest number: what is left after your commitments
• A repeating plan, so you set your budget once instead of every single month
• Annual dashboard with a whole-year heat table — every category, every month, at a glance
• Transactions tab with category and type charts, search, and filters
• Bank CSV import that reads any date format, remembers the categories you assign, and refuses duplicate uploads
• Savings goals and debt payoff goals, with optional cover photos and card or table views
• Recurring payments, a money calendar, and a weekly check-in that takes two minutes
• Wealth snapshots to track net worth month by month, kept separate from your budget
• Insights that point out what actually stands out in your numbers
• 8 colour themes, including two dark modes
• Works completely offline, on Mac or PC
• Full backup and restore, plus a printable view
• Illustrated how-to guide included

PERFECT FOR:
Getting a real handle on monthly spending, paying off a credit card or loan, saving for a house deposit or a trip, sinking funds, couples budgeting together, freelancers with uneven income, anyone leaving a messy spreadsheet behind, and anyone who wants a budget that stays private on their own computer.

Please note: this is a digital file, not a physical product. Nothing will be posted to you. Your data is stored in your own browser on your own device — this planner never uploads anything anywhere.
